codeReview.summary: I reviewed the feature entry in `features.json`, the relevant validation assertions in `validation-contract.md`, the worker transcript skeleton plus handoff for session `76399c88-5190-408e-8dca-777b2372be64`, the landed commit `838603405b77efa6398eb6105408d19e2941b3b4`, and reran the focused auth-broker/web tests named in the feature. The implementation and tests do prove org creation, caller-scoped visibility, and recipient-scoped accept/decline behavior, but they do not actually prove the required admin-side revoke path for a pending organization invite. Because VAL-ADMIN-003 explicitly requires clean revoke/cancel semantics, I cannot sign this feature off as fully verified.

issues.description: The broker suite proves removal of accepted org members and pending team members, but it never exercises a successful revoke of a pending organization invite. That leaves the canonical API proof for the VAL-ADMIN-003 admin-cancel path missing.

The web control-plane route tests only cover the org-member remove failure redirect, not the success path for revoking a pending org invite. The recorded manual run in `.factory/missions/a9640cd9-9c31-4920-b6d6-c9ce332fa599/handoffs/2026-03-25T07-15-43-098Z__org-admin-and-invite-lifecycle__76399c88-5190-408e-8dca-777b2372be64.json` shows the `Revoke invite` action rendering but never being completed, so the browser-facing revoke flow is still unproven.

sharedStateObservations.observation: This feature was not isolated to org-admin UI code; it changed shared auth-broker session behavior by hydrating management-token sessions from Better Auth user records and by issuing/using the bridged web session cookie on `/auth/account`.

The feature established `account-control-plane` as a shared web control-plane surface that later milestone work extended for teams and projects, so org/invite regressions now share files with subsequent admin features.

summary: The landed code looks coherent and the rerun focused tests are green, but the evidence set does not fully satisfy the feature contract because pending org-invite revoke is not directly verified at either the broker or browser-facing web layer.
